title: PostgreSQL Migration Lock Timeout - Zero Downtime Deploy Failed
impact: API write operations blocked for 82 min. Read operations unaffected. 0.3% of requests failed.
root_cause: ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN preferences JSONB acquired AccessExclusiveLock. Long-running analytics query (pid 2847) held AccessShareLock for 45 min. Migration timeout: 30s. Lock queue blocked all writes.
detection: Datadog alert: db.migration.duration > 30s. PagerDuty escalation to on-call.

response_timeline.action: Migration started via GitHub Actions deploy
Identifies blocking query: SELECT * FROM events WHERE created_at > '2024-01-01'

action_items.description: Implement advisory lock pattern for migrations

title: Let's Encrypt Certificate Renewal Failure - Wildcard Domain
impact: *.api.techcorp.io certificate expired. API clients with cert pinning failed. Browser users unaffected (Cloudflare edge cert valid).
root_cause: cert-manager ACME HTTP-01 challenge failed due to Cloudflare WAF blocking /.well-known/acme-challenge/ path. Rate limit hit after 5 retries.
detection: cert-manager CertificateReady=False condition. Monitoring alert: cert.expiry < 24h.

response_timeline.action: On-call checks cert-manager logs, sees HTTP-01 failures
Identifies Cloudflare WAF rule blocking challenge path
Creates Cloudflare WAF bypass rule for /.well-known/acme-challenge/*
Forces cert-manager renewal: kubectl delete certificate wildcard-api
Verifies cert deployed to all ingress controllers

action_items.description: Switch to DNS-01 challenge (Cloudflare API token)
Add cert-manager readiness probe to deployment

title: GitHub Actions Self-Hosted Runner Pool Exhaustion
impact: All CI pipelines queued for 80 min. 47 workflows blocked. Deploy pipeline blocked.
root_cause: Self-hosted runner scale-set maxed at 20 runners. Monorepo PR validation uses 15 concurrent. 3 runners unhealthy (disk full). No auto-scale trigger configured.
detection: GitHub Actions UI shows 'Waiting for runner' > 30 min. Slack alert from CI monitor bot.

response_timeline.action: On-call checks GitHub Actions runner status
Manually terminates stuck jobs, clears disk on unhealthy runners
Runners come back online, queue drains

action_items.description: Add disk space monitoring + auto-cleanup on runners
Set workflow concurrency limits per repo

title: Redis Cache Stampede on Feature Flag Service
impact: Feature flag evaluation latency spiked from 2ms to 2.5s. 15% of requests timed out. All services affected.
root_cause: Feature flag 'new-checkout-flow' expired at 12:30 UTC. 5000 concurrent requests hit cache miss simultaneously. All went to PostgreSQL for flag evaluation. DB CPU hit 100%.
detection: Datadog: redis.command.latency.p99 > 1s. PostgreSQL CPU > 95%. Service latency alerts.

response_timeline.action: On-call identifies hot key expiration pattern
Manually sets flag value in Redis (bypasses DB)

action_items.description: Implement cache-aside with distributed lock (Redis SETNX)
Add jitter to TTL: expire_at = base_ttl + random(0, 300s)
Add request coalescing for flag evaluation
Pre-warm cache on deployment for critical flags
